candidates.bottleneck: Classifier-visible residual interference at the final optical-SAR fusion interface.
candidates.operation_delta: Final post-fusion residual is decomposed by detached classifier Gram geometry and only its row-space displacement is bounded.
candidates.falsification_criterion: Best full-horizon mIoU gain below +1pp closes CTSP; +1 to <+2pp is marginal; controls open only at +2pp.
candidates.resource_risk: AMP interaction and numerical stability of calibrated tau; no additional attention or backbone pass.
candidates.nearest_prior_art: SING classifier invariants, CLEAR cross-modal projection, DOLG orthogonal fusion, TokenFusion and CROMA.
candidates.what_is_not_new: Pseudoinverse, null/tangent geometry, residual clipping, multimodal fusion, CROMA and optical-SAR segmentation.

prior_art_assessment.nearest_prior_art: SING classifier range/null invariants; CLEAR cross-modal covariance projection; DOLG orthogonal feature fusion; TokenFusion; CROMA and optical-SAR fusion.
prior_art_assessment.new_axis: Bounded classifier-visible displacement of an already formed optical-SAR residual while preserving its tangent complement at the fixed EO VFM interface.
prior_art_assessment.novelty_claim_boundary: Only the narrow CTSP residual operation is tested; all geometry, fusion, CROMA and dataset components are not claimed new.
prior_art_assessment.what_is_not_new: Pseudoinverse, null/tangent projection, residual clipping, multimodal fusion, CROMA and SEN12TS.

training_object_contract.candidate_new_parameter_initialization: none; parameter-free CTSP uses detached shared classifier geometry
